The alternate barycentric map retracts the bridge to the original neighborhood complex. Pairwise edge-disjoint square boundaries give a primitive cellular boundary inclusion, torsion-free first homology and no higher homology. Equivariant Hopf trace gives the exact signed fixed-square formula. An independent finite simplicial Lefschetz checker passed 386 automorphism actions over 126 eligible Graph Atlas graph types plus 12 larger cases.

originality.rationale: The directly closest complete 2026 primary statement gives only the nonequivariant graph-plus-square model, Euler ranks and wedges; it expressly does not claim graph-automorphism equivariance. Neither that statement, the no-four-cycle equivariant theorem of Kamibeppu, nor the different global quadrangulation theorem determines this canonical integral automorphism-module presentation or uniform signed fixed-square trace for graphs with squares. Some elements of the new character may be derivable from the old canonical construction using extra equivariant technology, but the extra lemma and its signs are proved, rather than assumed.
residual_risks: The canonical nature of the prior nonequivariant square model may allow the action character to be deduced using general equivariant nerve theory; no covering published statement was identified.
Equivalent unindexed representation-theoretic results remain possible.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a natural integral automorphism-module presentation and complete rational symmetry character on an infinite class that can contain multiple edge-disjoint four-cycles, triangles, leaves and irregular graph symmetries. A signed orbit of lifted square boundaries changes automorphism traces even when Betti ranks agree. It answers a motivated equivariant classification question, not merely a small numerical enhancement of known Euler characteristics.
